method_notes: Same 16 prompt templates, permissions, state isolation and execution limits as baseline.
Qwen explicitly uses local/chat because default free/chat still rejects with 503; this is a separate configuration from the baseline.
Exact artifact target path/reference is required for task success. This scorer strengthening was reapplied to all original baseline runs and changed none of their success outcomes.
A native model response can be structurally correct while the required artifact state is wrong; run status alone is not task success.
One trial per case; order remains DeepSeek then Qwen; cache uncontrolled.
Partial model requests may have missing usage; no verified tariff, API cost remains null.
No production gateway or local-ai configuration changed; dedicated test agent model changed only.
